## TemplateManager.\_compile() method

Compiles a raw template string and stores the result in the cache.

**Signature:**

```typescript
_compile(key: string, template: string, keepIfExist?: Partial<{
        [K in keyof ITCompiledTemplate]: boolean;
    }>, importCache?: Map<string, string>, rawCache?: Map<string, string>, filename?: string): void;
```

**Returns:**

## Remarks

This method processes import blocks, compiles media, polls, messages, keyboards, and descriptions from the template. It uses `TemplateEngine` for compilation. The `keepIfExist` parameter allows partial recompilation when only specific template parts have changed.

## Example


```typescript
this._compile("welcome", rawHtmlContent)

const importCache = new Map<string, string>()
const rawCache = new Map([["partial", partialHtml]])
this._compile("main", mainHtml, undefined, importCache, rawCache)
```
